title: arenaria arvensis
intro: Arenaria arvensis, commonly known as Sandwort or Spring Sandwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is native to Europe and Western Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful for treating various health conditions such as skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria arvensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
